project_name: PT. VRCHINDO Digital Solutions - Smart Warehouse & Multi-Marketplace ERP
archetype: High-Density Command ERP (Swiss Precision + Kinetic Modern)

framework_notes.theme_support: Light & Dark Mode Switcher (Persisted via LocalStorage/State)
framework_notes.pwa_support: Mobile Responsive with Bottom Nav & Service Worker Install Prompt

forbidden_colors_check.ai_page: #7351B7 forbidden for pure background - gradient permitted

top_header.description: Fixed header with gradient background, containing PT. VRCHINDO logo with live green status dot, mobile menu toggle, quick product search, calculator tool button, calendar/date tool, POS button, Pengiriman Paket quick action, live clock 'HH:mm:ss WIB', live date 'Hari, DD MMMM YYYY', dark mode switcher, notifications bell with count, user avatar dropdown.
top_header.sticky_class: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-950 via-indigo-900 to-blue-900 text-white shadow-md px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between

sidebar.description: Collapsible sidebar with white background in light mode and dark slate in dark mode. Grouped with uppercase category labels: DASHBOARD, DATA INTERNAL GUDANG, PENGIRIMAN PAKET, MARKETPLACE HUB (BIG SELLER), POS & SALES, MANAGEMENT & LAPORAN, SETTINGS.
sidebar.items_style: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800

scanner_section.description: Barcode & Camera Scanner module with high focus outline, manual barcode text input, camera toggle switch, quick audio beep effect toggle, and prominent green 'PROCESS / SCAN' action button.

data_table.density: Compact high-density table padding py-2.5 px-3 with zebra striping in dark/light mode

pwa_mobile_bottom_nav.description: Fixed bottom bar on small viewports with quick items: Dashboard, Scanner, Gudang, Marketplace Chat, and Profile.

internal_gudang_only: Stok Riil (Formula: Awal + In + Return - Out)
Batas Minimum Stok Alert & Reorder Point
HPP (Harga Pokok Penjualan) & Harga Jual Internal
Form Penyesuaian Stok (Stock Adjustment with Reason & Audit Log)
bigseller_marketplace_module: Integrasi Multi-Akun Marketplace (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada)
Unified Chat Inbox (Pesan Masuk dari Semua Akun & Marketplace)
Pengaturan Massal (Bulk Edit Promo, Harga Coret, Diskon, Deskripsi Produk, Foto Showcase)

interactive_modals.calculator_modal: Pop-up interactive calculator tool with basic arithmetic (+, -, *, /) and percentage calculator for rapid price/discount check.
interactive_modals.date_calendar_modal: Popup calendar picker with quick filter shortcuts (Hari Ini, 7 Hari Terakhir, Bulan Ini, Custom Range).
interactive_modals.pos_shortcut_modal: Quick cashier screen for direct counter sales.
interactive_modals.stock_adjustment_modal: Popup form for updating warehouse stock with audit trail.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Contrast ratio > 4.5:1 for table data and status pills
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, and KPI values MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='header-calculator-button', data-testid='kpi-pesanan-diproses-value', data-testid='scan-barcode-input', data-testid='table-order-row-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade React ERP application using the provided design hierarchy.
Recreate exact screenshot structure: Top gradient bar + left sidebar + sub-tab navigation + top banner + KPI cards with colored top border + barcode scan panel + rich data table.
Ensure complete separation between 'Data Internal Gudang' and 'BigSeller Marketplace Hub'.
Include working Calculator modal, live clock with seconds (WIB timezone format), live date display in Indonesian, and Multi-Marketplace Chat Inbox tab.
Support Dark Mode toggle with seamless persistence and full visual contrast.
Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes for automated testing.
